summary: Comprehensive backend testing for AI SDR Agent completed. All 27 pytest tests passed (100% success). Verified: health, JWT auth (signup/login/me + 401 cases), Settings GET/PUT with persistence, Lead CRUD with real GPT-5.2 qualification (score 96 verified for high-intent Stripe lead, industry=Fintech, buying_intent=Very High, 5 key_signals, personalized email mentioning Stripe/SOC2/Q1), public lead capture endpoint, owner isolation (secondary user cannot see demo user's leads/GETs return 404), status update appends activity, regenerate-email adds second email_generated activity, delete verifies removal, analytics summary with all required fields (total_leads, qualified_leads, conversion_rate, avg_score, score_distribution buckets, by_industry, timeline, ai_insights), activity feed. Mocked integrations (HubSpot, Slack, n8n) correctly return status='mocked' in activity metadata when credentials unset. Real LLM output verified via curl inspection — not falling back to heuristic.

minor.issue: score_distribution.buckets '40-64' overlaps with model.score rubric ('40-64 mid' in prompt) — internally consistent but the qualification pipeline uses >=50 as qualified threshold while distribution has different buckets; consider aligning thresholds.
PytestRemovedIn10Warning: class-scoped fixture defined as instance method (created_lead) — cosmetic, harmless.

critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: JWT_SECRET default value in .env is 'change-me-super-secret-jwt-key-2026' — must be rotated before production. Currently acceptable for preview.

server.py:_run_ai_pipeline is called synchronously inside POST /api/leads and can take 5-15s (two LLM calls). Consider a background task + polling or SSE to improve UX for slow LLM responses; documented as expected in the request.
server.py:list_leads uses limit=200 default without pagination — fine for MVP but add page/skip params before scale.
server.py:analytics_summary loads up to 2000 leads into memory to compute buckets/timeline — replace with Mongo aggregation pipeline once volumes grow.

models.py: Qualification is not Optional on Lead (default_factory=Qualification) — a lead that failed both LLM and heuristic would still have an empty Qualification object which is fine, but confirm the API contract intentionally never returns null.
ai_service.py: session_id is a fresh uuid per call — no conversation memory issues, but confirm no cost implications for /session storage.
integrations.py: sync_to_hubspot posts even when qualification is empty (score None); guard against firing HubSpot for failed qualifications.
test_credentials: demo@sdr.ai / demo1234 (existing). Tests also create TEST_-prefixed users dynamically.
seed_data_creation: Several TEST_-prefixed users and leads created in demo user's account during test run; not cleaned up (Mongo is a preview DB, low volume).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. GPT-5.2 via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is working (real output verified with score 96 and Stripe-specific email body). Owner isolation, mocked integrations, and 401/404 error paths all pass. If retesting, first run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v. Watch for LLM 'Budget exceeded' errors in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log — historic errors seen from an earlier session; fallback heuristic handles it if it recurs but tests still assert score >= 50 on high-intent leads which both paths satisfy.
